name: snapvote
description: Password-protected multiplayer photo party game (Kahoot-style) running free on Cloudflare Workers.

SITE_PASSWORD.description: The **player password**. Give it to everyone who plays; they enter it once per phone. At least 8 characters, e.g. `sunset-waffle-4821`.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The **admin password**, only for you. It's needed to host games, open the admin panel and download photos. At least 8 characters and **different** from the player password.
